blogs.title: Finetuning Giant LLMs on a Single GPU: The QLoRA Breakthrough
blogs.description: An overview of how QLoRA makes it possible to fine‑tune a 65‑billion‑parameter model on a single 48 GB GPU. The post explains the memory challenges of traditional 16‑bit training, introduces the key innovations (NF4 quantization, double quantization, and paged optimizers), and shows why this matters for researchers and hobbyists.

blogs.title: Decoding NF4: The Optimal 4‑Bit Data Type for LLM Weights
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into the new NormalFloat‑4 (NF4) format introduced in QLoRA. The article explains the statistical motivation (normally distributed weights), how NF4 differs from classic int4/float4, and why it yields better accuracy while keeping the model tiny.

blogs.title: Low‑Rank Adapters Meet Quantized Models: How LoRA Powers QLoRA
blogs.description: Explains the role of LoRA adapters in QLoRA, why gradients are back‑propagated through frozen 4‑bit weights, and how using adapters at every layer recovers full 16‑bit performance. Includes practical tips for setting LoRA hyperparameters when fine‑tuning massive models.

blogs.title: From Benchmarks to Real Chatbots: Guanaco’s Rise to ChatGPT‑Level Performance
blogs.description: Shows how the authors used QLoRA to train the Guanaco family of models, compares their Vicuna and MMLU scores with ChatGPT, GPT‑4, and other open‑source bots, and discusses why data quality (e.g., OASST1) trumps dataset size.

blogs.title: Evaluating Language Models with GPT‑4 vs. Humans: Insights from QLoRA Experiments
blogs.description: Analyzes the authors’ novel evaluation pipeline—automated GPT‑4 scoring, Elo tournaments, and human AMT judgments. Discusses agreement levels, ordering effects, and what this tells us about cheap yet reliable model evaluation.

blogs.title: Beyond the Numbers: Qualitative Strengths and Weaknesses of QLoRA‑Fine‑Tuned Chatbots
blogs.description: Presents a user‑friendly review of the “lemons” and “cherries” discovered in Guanaco’s responses—factual recall, mathematics, suggestibility, refusal behavior, and theory‑of‑mind capabilities—illustrating where quantized fine‑tuning shines and where it still falls short.

blogs.title: Turning Your Laptop into an LLM Lab: Practical Guide to Running QLoRA
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step tutorial for enthusiasts who want to fine‑tune their own LLMs with QLoRA on a consumer GPU. Covers environment setup, installing bitsandbytes kernels, preparing LoRA adapters, and tips for avoiding out‑of‑memory errors with paged optimizers.
